svg.text: The routing policy's training: the whole data flow
black arrows: the data. Below: every wait the code has now (green), and what it replaced (red, as of 8168f512).
1 SYNTHESIS: cases (py/route/cases.py, numpy)
rng -> fabric (6 kinds) , stream (collectives,
arrivals on their floors), window
(dt, lag, refreshes, warm router, burst),
h0 (zero | sigma N(0,1) | pool), keys
out: case[n] (struct route_case records)
pool <- states runs ended with
2 SYNTHESIS: rollouts (py/route/loop.py Rollouts.tick; sims.c, net.swift)
sim (sim.c, CPU, one per run) policy forward (GPU, int8 minGRU)
fabric state at tau_k
-> tokens: lanes [L][IN], contexts [C][IN] (route.h features) -----> h, tokens -> w [C][FS], h'
pieces move; each draw (v, S): table over deg^|S| splits
logit = 10 tanh(w . phi / sqrt 40), masked, softmax, sample (CPU, per draw)
phi = split features from the draw's live lane waits
run ends: costs (completion / floor), draws by refresh
out (a run): h0, tokens_k, w_k, draws_k, costs (kept in the simulators' arena until loaded)
a split's features, logit and table: split.h, ONE definition (the sampler, the credit, the checks' score)
two halves of the slots alternate: one simulates (CPU, one parallel pass) while the other's forward runs (GPU)
3 LOADING: a learning batch (loop.load, numpy)
runs (4 a case)
-> advantage: T - mean(T of the other 3)
-> rows: each refresh's drawn contexts' tokens
-> segments (a refresh's rows), lane rows, h0
-> credit inputs: draws, first draw a row,
behaviour w, task-0 scale
out: sims_export, one parallel copy into
the batch's shared buffers
4 TRAINING (GPU, ONE command buffer a step: route_net_step)
forward again (the same network, theta now) -> w_cur
credit: per draw ratio x (psi - E psi) under w_cur (score function; ratio = pi_cur / pi_behaviour)
backward through the refreshes (int8 products, three tasks: throughput, latency, queueing)
-> grads [3][P], gram [3][3]
EXCHANGE (world 4): grads copied into the lease, summed across ranks (libnccl-mesh) in the same command buffer
OPTIMIZER: gram -> UPGrad (upgrad.h, on the GPU) -> Adam -> pin V -> int8 codes = theta
theta -> the actor: route_net_publish, two shared events (staged, consumed): no CPU wait
case[n]
records
batch
theta -> the rollouts' forward
end states -> pool
The waits now (green), each the data's own; and what they replaced (red):
- per run, per refresh: 4 lock hand-offs, 2 broadcasts waking every worker, 55 KB copied into new arrays
-> none: one parallel pass a half (sims_step), tokens kept in the arena, packed once (sims_pack)
- per forward: a command buffer, completion by lock + broadcast; a service thread
-> route_net_wait on a half's forward, before that half simulates on (its w)
- per optimizer step: 3 CPU waits; theta copied to the producers WAITED behind their forwards
-> none: learn, exchange, optimizer one command buffer; theta by shared events
- per step: gram read back to the CPU for UPGrad; ratios summed on the CPU
-> none: UPGrad on the GPU; ratios summed in the step's completion handler
- per exchange: a thread, a CPU wait on the mesh, the gradient copied 3x; gram computed again
-> none on the CPU: the sum in the step's command buffer, through the lease
- per case: room/push handshake, caseLock x4, 12 KB struct copies into a queue
-> route_net_wait on a learning batch before it is filled again (two alternate)
